title: Dr. Benway
summary: Dr. Benway is a member of the Organization who fought against his leader, the Professor, for control of Kronos. He is a descendant of Viktor Casterwill, who betrayed the Casterwill family, making him a disowned member of the Casterwill clan. His assistant is Miss Fitch.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dr. Benway grew up as a disowned Casterwill, growing up in an old mansion in Prague and inheriting Kronos from his ancestor Viktor Casterwill who had betrayed the Casterwill family by stealing the Kronos' Ring from the Astronomical Clock of Prague. [The Power of Kronos]

Dr. Benway and the Professor fought each other for ownership of the Ring of Kronos with the Professor coming out victorious, leaving Benway hospitalised. He used Araknos to put Benway in a wheelchair for good and become a loyal scientist and advisor to the Organization. The Professor often attempted to summon Kronos but never succeeded. [The Power of Kronos] After the defeat of the Professor, Araknos' hold over Dr. Benway was broken. He reclaimed Kronos's Ring, and also helped himself to the most powerful Titans in the Organization's collection. [The Power of Kronos] He set about trying to gain control of the Organization and used the services of the mercenary Rahmas to get himself to a high status. However, Benway disappeared before he could pay Rahmas much to his annoyance.[Cerberus (comic)] 

After years of his experts' failed attempts, Benway succeeded in obtaining the Amulet of the Titan Cerberus after posing as an Italian archaeologist and tricking Dante Vale into recovering it for him. He sent the Titan to attack the Huntik team and then attempted to execute Dante and Rahmas who he had also betrayed. However, Benway and his team were defeated by Dante and Rahmas, inadvertently working together. Dante took Cerberus' Amulet from Benway before giving it to Rahmas in exchange for him calling him back to his Amulet and saving the Huntik team. [Cerberus (comic)]

When the Huntik team launched a mission to obtain the Ring of Kronos, Benway set a trap with Miss Fitch and lured them to his base. Summoning Kronos, he attempted to use him to wipe Lok and Sophie from existence, but missing, created a vortex that sucked in, sending them back in time to the seventeenth century. The Ring of Kronos vanished much to Benway's despair. This was, in fact, due to Lok and Sophie altering the past, stopping Viktor Casterwill from taking the Ring, therefore preventing it from ever falling into Benway's hands. He and his accomplices were arrested by the Huntik Foundation while Lok and Sophie returned to the present day after getting help from one Michel de Notre Dame. [The Power of Kronos]

== Personality ==
Benway was cruel and self-centred, and often used deception to get one over those around him. He betrayed Rahmas to avoid paying him for his work, and attempted to execute him and Dante Vale, showing no limit to his evil. However, he was also brave enough to take on the Professor, a move that cost him his ability to walk. 

== Abilities ==
Although in a wheelchair, Dr. Benway possessed a wide range of powers as he was able to hold his own against the Professor. He was also able to summon the incredibly unstable Legendary Titan of Time, Kronos, something the Professor himself was unable to do. [The Power of Kronos] After the Professor's defeat, he helped himself to some of the most powerful Titans in the Organization's collection. [The Power of Kronos]

=== Spells Utilized ===
* Armorbrand

===Bonded Titans===
* Cerberus (Taken by Dante, given to Rahmas)
* Kronos (Lost after Lok and Sophie changed history)
